name: Mindread
source:
Julius catches up with his high school sweetheart at a cafe. 

Everything is going fine, but there's something Mark's not saying...will Julius learn the truth or are some things best left in the past?

[From [url=https://stuwudio.itch.io/mindread]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
朱利叶斯在咖啡馆与高中时的恋人重聚，聊起彼此的近况。

一切都很顺利，可马克似乎有什么话没说出口……朱利叶斯能知道真相吗？还是说，有些事情最好永远留在过去？

（摘自[url=https://stuwudio.itch.io/mindread]itch.io[/url]）
